text: Rei Tasaka, Senior Urban Design Manager, Waterfront Toronto, and Bryan Bowen, Waterfront Project Manager, Waterfront Secretariat, City Planning, City of Toronto, will give a presentation on Marine Strategy Update and Implementation. The presentation will provide an overview of Waterfront Toronto's Marine Use Strategy Study which is an update to the existing 2006 Study. Preliminary data will be presented, including an inventory of existing marine uses in Lake Ontario's Inner Harbour and next steps for the Study, including further engagement with First Nations communities.
The Aboriginal Affairs Advisory Committee received the item for information.
